usage: deskops add pill [-h] [--root ROOT] [--from-yaml FROM_YAML]
                        [--title TITLE] [--summary SUMMARY]
                        [--tags TAGS [TAGS ...]] [--what WHAT] [--why WHY]
                        [--when WHEN] [--where WHERE] [--how HOW]
                        [--how-not HOW_NOT]

Create a pill artifact.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           Target repository root.
  --from-yaml FROM_YAML
                        Load the pill payload from a YAML file.
  --title TITLE         Pill title, including semantic prefix when useful, such as 'ADR:' or 'Pattern:'.
  --summary SUMMARY     Short semantic summary for the pill.
  --tags TAGS [TAGS ...]
                        Semantic tags placed at the end, using namespaced forms such as 'language:python' or 'library:pydantic'.
  --what WHAT           What the pill defines or clarifies.
  --why WHY             Why this context matters for implementation or refactoring.
  --when WHEN           When this pill should be applied.
  --where WHERE         Where this pill applies, either as general scope or as references to existing code or docs.
  --how HOW             How to apply the guidance in practice.
  --how-not HOW_NOT     How not to apply the guidance or what to avoid.

Example:
  deskops add pill --root . --title "Example"
